title: Fine-tuning: data splits, LoRA and independent evaluation
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects fine-tuning: data splits, lora and independent evaluation with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Choose adaptation only if held-out gains justify operational complexity.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Prompting changes instructions, RAG supplies changing evidence, and fine-tuning changes model parameters for repeated task behavior. Fine-tuning is not a reliable way to maintain rapidly changing facts or enforce authorization. Start with a baseline and a measured failure pattern before paying training and maintenance costs.

Supervised fine-tuning uses input/target examples. LoRA learns low-rank update matrices while keeping base weights frozen; PEFT is a broader family of parameter-efficient methods. These reduce trainable parameters, not the need for careful data and evaluation.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Create reviewed training examples with UNKNOWN and difficult classes, group related incidents to prevent leakage and reserve a held-out evaluation set. The optional local lab trains a tiny text classifier with torch; the PEFT example uses a configured public base checkpoint and LoRA adapter with explicit download/cost requirements.

Record base/tokenizer revisions, training hyperparameters, data hash and adapter artifacts. Compare against prompting and RAG baselines on accepted accuracy, calibration, safety, latency and total cost. Preserve source evidence outside weights.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: Near-duplicate incidents appear in training and test, inflating accuracy. A fine-tuned model memorizes synthetic secret strings. Training loss falls while held-out performance declines, indicating overfitting.
Test deduplication and grouped splits, evaluate rare classes and check that unsupported requests still abstain. Red-team the adapted model and do not infer security from a lower training loss.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Choose adaptation only if held-out gains justify operational complexity. Report what improved, what regressed and how the adapter can be disabled or rolled back.

For SDETs, the training pipeline itself needs contracts: split disjointness, label schema, finite losses, saved/reloaded equivalence and stable evaluation. Fine-tuning acceptance is based on independent task evidence.

takeaway: Choose adaptation only if held-out gains justify operational complexity.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: LoRA parameterizes an update as low-rank factors rather than training every base weight. For an output-by-input matrix, factors with rank r use r times input+output trainable parameters. This reduces trainable state but does not prove better task behavior or reduce every inference cost automatically.

Initializing an adapter and running a forward pass are integration checks. Fine-tuning additionally optimizes it on reviewed examples, and acceptance additionally evaluates a held-out task and safety dataset.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: The optional PEFT script requires a chosen compatible public checkpoint and target projection names. It builds a sequence-classification adapter, checks output shape and saves the initialized adapter with an explicit untrained label. Use the real PyTorch training lab to understand optimizer, loss and holdout mechanics before extending the adapter script.

Record training examples, base/tokenizer revisions, rank, alpha, dropout and adapter artifact. Use grouped splits and compare prompting/RAG/baseline alternatives on the same independent evaluation cases.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A developer presents initialized adapter weights as a fine-tuned model. Another selects target module names from a different architecture and attaches no useful trainable projections. Training loss falls while test performance declines.
Inspect trainable parameter counts and gradient flow, run saved/reloaded equivalence and evaluate unknown/rare cases. Check data contamination and privacy behavior before serving an adapted model.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Acceptance distinguishes initialized, trained and evaluated artifacts in both filenames and reports. A trained adapter is promoted only if held-out gains justify its maintenance and rollback cost.
